body: Promise-credibility forward test, Nov-2026 cohort (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Orchid Pharma (ORCHPHARMA). Probability 0.21 (naive sector base rate 0.26) that: Orchid Pharma (ORCHPHARMA) commissions the cefiderocol plant by 31-Dec-2026. Probabilities set only by the pre-registered rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/forward_test_2026-11/prereg.md s4): p0 = 0.265 (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'dates' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=34); SAC -0.409 x w 0.130 (N=3) -> P_cred = 0.21. Evidence: call of 2026-11-17: "Our current target remains commissioning by December 2026, followed by validation and initial batches between January and March of '27" (Q2FY27). Resolution: YES if an NSE filing, press release or the Q3FY27 call states the cefiderocol facility was commissioned (mechanically complete/operational) on or before 31-Dec-2026; an inauguration alone is not commissioning unless the text says the plant is commissioned. Source: company Q3/Q4 FY27 filings, presentations and call transcripts (NSE). Resolve by 2027-03-15; score Brier of P_cred vs P_base (prereg s5).

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.265 (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'dates' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=34); SAC -0.409 x w 0.130 (N=3) -> P_cred = 0.21
data.adjustment_rule: P_cred = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC, 0.05, 0.95); SAC = mean(y - p0(group)) over the company's resolved past promises (strict: delivered=1, else 0); N<3 -> P_cred = p0. P_base = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = leave-one-out strict delivery rate of Healthcare peers in group 'dates' (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'dates' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=34). No company-specific information.
data.promise_quote: "Our current target remains commissioning by December 2026, followed by validation and initial batches between January and March of '27" (Q2FY27)
data.resolution_rule: YES if an NSE filing, press release or the Q3FY27 call states the cefiderocol facility was commissioned (mechanically complete/operational) on or before 31-Dec-2026; an inauguration alone is not commissioning unless the text says the plant is commissioned.

title: Paper call: Orchid Pharma (ORCHPHARMA) commissions the cefiderocol plant by 31-Dec-2026
